relevance_note: A retrospective single-centre review of anakinra use in autoinflammatory and hyperinflammatory conditions ('SJIA, CAPS, MKD, SURF, PIMS-TS, Other AID'); the paper never mentions TNFAIP3, A20 or HA20, so it describes no in-scope person.
method_note: Read the whole Markdown by eye; a case-insensitive text search for 'TNFAIP3', 'A20', 'haploinsufficiency' and 'HA20' found only a page number ('e276–e88') in reference 36. The diagnoses listed (Table 1 and its notes) are SJIA, CAPS, MKD, SURF, PIMS-TS, Blau syndrome, PAPA syndrome, NLRC4-AID and polyarticular JIA; none is HA20 and no TNFAIP3 variant is described. Only the publications row is filled. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients left null: the CAPS paragraph cites reference (30), the authors' own Muckle-Wells family report, after a statement about two patients, but the paper does not say explicitly that these patients were described there. n_patients_reported left null because the authors do not state a number of TNFAIP3 carriers. No contradictions found.

study_type.span: Clinical data from electronic records were retrospectively reviewed for patients treated with anakinra over the past 6 years for autoinflammatory diseases (AID).

cohort_size_as_stated.span: From 47 patients (27 female patients) who fulfilled inclusion criteria
